citations.assessment: The midrash names R. Berekhya and R. Ḥelbo together in Yishmael bar Naḥman’s name. This differs from the Ekev chain.
The seventeenth chapter gives Yishmael bar Naḥman on Yehoshua’s three proclamations.
The passage in Tanchuma Ekev matches the distinct Bar Neḥemyah patronymic and the chain Berekhya through Ḥelbo. The link identifies this textual parallel to the inherited Yelammedenu attribution.
The indexed text gives Yishmael bar Rav Naḥman in the saying that proper conduct preceded Torah.
The checked source gives R. Shemuel bar Naḥmani. Preserve Heilprin’s abbreviated patronymic notice and document the first name in the named witness.
The text expressly gives Yudan in Yishmael bar Naḥman’s name, introducing the parable of the king’s garment.

The identified Metzorah passage has the same chain in chapter 16 of the indexed digital edition. The later chapter 17 citation refers to a distinct teaching and Heilprin’s locator is retained in the English.
